product.name: Treema AI Operating System
product.description: A cloud-based platform for hospitality and vacation rental teams to manage tasks, workflows, and team collaboration using AI-driven automation and real-time insights.

product.name: Task Management
product.description: A feature to assign, track, and prioritize tasks with statuses, deadlines, attachments, and comments to facilitate team cooperation in hospitality operations.

product.name: Housekeeping Checklists
product.description: Digital checklists to manage daily cleaning routines, track brand standards, and perform maintenance spot checks in hospitality properties.

product.name: Real-time Collaboration Tools
product.description: Tools enabling instant communication, news sharing, and updates among hospitality teams to enhance teamwork and operational coordination.

product.name: Dashboards & Analytics
product.description: Customizable dashboards providing real-time insights and analytics on tasks, team performance, and operational metrics for hospitality management.

product.name: Workflow Automation
product.description: Automation of standard operating procedures and brand standards through flexible workflows to streamline hospitality operations.
